# ByteBolt

> ByteBolt (also called Bolt) is a free video downloader for PC. Paste a link, choose a quality up to 8K, and save videos or audio from 1800+ websites. It has no ads, no subscriptions and no hidden data collection. It is built and maintained by one developer.

## Key facts

- Platform: PC
- Price: free
- Supported sites: 1800+ (social media sites, video sites and pages with embedded video)
- Quality: up to 16K, depending on what the source video offers
- Output formats: MP4, MP3, MOV, WebM, AVI, WMV, AVCHD, FLV and more
- Extra features: trim before download, download audio only, download captions in any language, download playlists donwload channels bulk download included
- Support: support@bytebolt.app

## Pages

- [Home](https://bytebolt.app/): what ByteBolt does, features, and how to download a video in 3 steps
- [About](https://bytebolt.app/about): the goal of the project, who built it, and a FAQ (is it free, is it safe, supported sites, bug reports)
- [Release notes](https://bytebolt.app/whatsnew): changelog with every version
- [Privacy](https://bytebolt.app/privacy): privacy policy
- [EULA](https://bytebolt.app/eula): license terms
